title: Finite-level quotient transport
statement: For every f, F, y and n, the formal module quotient by the extended maximal ideal power is isomorphic to the pushforward of the finite-fibre pullback, compatibly with formalFunctionsFiniteFMap.

proof.text: Use the finite map closedness and the same pasted pullback square. Its canonical pullback isomorphism, ker_comp_of_isIso, and clause (1) of quotientBaseChange_closedImmersion_ideal identify its kernel with the extension of formalFibreIdeal. Clause (2), quotientBaseChange_extendedIdeal_mul_pow, identifies this ideal with the (n+1)-st power of J.

Use the existing private Scheme.Modules.power_mono and Scheme.Modules.power_subobject lemmas from IdealPowerProductRestrictionZero, imported with import all, to identify the recursive idealSheafPower inclusion with (J^(n+1)).toModulesι as subobjects. Whiskering their subobject isomorphism with the arbitrary F gives equal multiplication-image subobjects. Subobject.isoOfMkEqMk and cokernel.mapIso produce a quotient isomorphism compatible with quotient projections. This is the fully proved private power_quotient_iso argument; no affine separatedness, range factorization or power-subobject proof is duplicated locally.

Apply closedImmersion_unit_quotient to the finite map and F prime. Its isomorphic quotient map gives an isomorphism from the cokernel of multiplication by the kernel ideal to pushforward of tensorPullback of F prime. Transport the previous quotient comparison by the kernel equality; its projection followed by this isomorphism is the closed-immersion adjunction unit.

Compose the chosen tensorPullback adjunction for the local projection with the adjunction used in the closed-immersion unit theorem. Use pushforwardCongr for formalFunctionsFiniteι_snd and pushforwardComp to identify its right adjoint with pushforward along formalFibreι. The conjugateIsoEquiv of this right-adjoint isomorphism supplies the tensor-pullback comparison. Mathlib unit_conjugateEquiv_symm and injectivity of the local-projection Hom equivalence prove the precise unit equation defining formalFunctionsFiniteFMap, without assuming two separately chosen adjunctions coincide. Compose the quotient isomorphism, the closed-immersion quotient isomorphism, and the pushforward of this comparison. Their three projection equations, with associativity, give the required equation.

theorem formalFunctionsFinite_sheaf_quotient_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (y : Y) (n : ℕ) :
    let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F
    let J := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      ((maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).map
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv.hom)).comap
          (pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)
    ∃ e : formalModuleQuotient J (n + 1) F' ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (formalFunctionsFiniteι f y n)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F),
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F' ≫ e.hom =
        formalFunctionsFiniteFMap f y F n
